page.overview:
Who is Dhalsim's family?

Dhalsim's family, who live with him in India. His wife and son also practice yoga, while his wife can't stretch like Dhalsim but their son can.

Sally is seen in Dhalsim's endings from Super Street Fighter II Turbo, Street Fighter Alpha 2, and X-Men vs. Street Fighter, and Marvel Super Heroes vs. Street Fighter, and also in the background of Dhalsim's India stages from Street Fighter Alpha 2 and Street Fighter Alpha 3. In these stages, whenever Dhalsim is participating as one of the combatants, she can be seen clapping her hands joyfully whenever her husband successfully lands an attack on his opponent, but shaking her head in disappointment whenever the opponent lands an attack on him. If he wins a round, she happily spins and jumps into the air, while if he loses a round, she falls to her knees, puts her head into her hands, and seemingly cries over his loss.

In Super Street Fighter IV, Sally is in the background of the Exciting Street Scene stage, though she won't pay any fight much mind unless her husband is participating. In Street Fighter V, she appears with Datta in the background of the Apprentice Alley stage. She is also present in the Action Card Grace from the first two SNK vs. Capcom: Card Fighters games.
